data.content:
* * *

## [One of my worst shopping experiences to date](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a0b130a7c794f25a2fd44a7)

Delivery was outrageously expensive and box arrived damaged (over $100 to ship PILLOWS??)

Two of the pillows were the wrong ones. I was later informed that they didn't have the ones I originally ordered.

In one of the pillows I found a tag from the supplier for $55 for the pillow cover. Lulu and Georgia *charged me $318 for that pillow*. Absolutely insane markup that cannot be justified.

Incredibly problematic on multiple fronts. I really wanted to have a good experience with my first order because the stuff is really cute, but I cannot support these types of business practices.

May 6, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 18, 2026

Hi Rachel,

We’re very sorry for the frustration and inconvenience caused by this experience. We understand how disappointing the shipping issues, damaged packaging, and unavailable items were.

We do see that a member of our team assisted with this matter, and we truly appreciate your patience while the refund was processed and reflected.

Thank you for your feedback, and we apologize again that your first experience did not meet expectations.
